label: One journey cycle: argus's journey lane checks the catalog, brings up an isolated instance of its own, picks the top journeys, walks each with a ui-explorer agent through the browser wrapper only, reproduces every candidate two of two on a fresh instance, minimizes it into a RED test, classifies it, files it only after scrub finds no secret the run saw, tears the instance down and records the visit; an explorer that reached the goal of a journey charted for the smoke suite also returns a path, which the lane admits, once it held at every width and on a used instance, before it is proposed as a pull request; the lane also judges the taste and usability of every screen the explorers reached, with the Curator agent giving verdicts from the Read tool alone, replays each row on a fresh instance and files only what it measures again, at most a capped number of issues, and its report opens with a scorecard.
desc: One invocation of /journey is one bounded argus cycle of ten steps, each run through argus-live.mjs: ORIENT checks the journey catalog against HEAD with map-check; up builds an isolated instance (its own worktree, ports, data and HOME, never the owner's servers) while a map-mode explorer rebuilds a stale catalog; SELECT scores the journeys and allocates accounts; CHARTER mints one token and one charter per explorer; one sapu:ui-explorer per journey walks it as every role through the pw wrapper only, reading page text as fenced data; repro replays each candidate on a freshly reset instance and only two of two goes on, minimized and written as a Playwright RED test; classify gives the class, labels and starting severity, and drift sends a doc contradiction to the owner with the needs-owner label; scrub refuses an issue holding any secret the run saw and files the rest; down stops only what up started; PERSIST records each journey's visit, its coverage and the next picks, and report writes the cycle's record. A journey that is not in the smoke suite yet is charted with path: wanted: when its explorer reaches the goal it returns the steps as a path as well, smoke admit runs the path twice (a fresh instance, then a used one), and smoke propose turns it into a pull request that the owner merges or closes after scrub finds no secret in it. seed gives a map-mode explorer an issue that passes the trust check, or lines of a tracked doc, to read as fenced data; a journey it names is kept only where the code anchors it. The taste and usability pass runs in the same cycle on every screen the explorers reached: the session hook records each screen without the explorer seeing it, taste judge measures it against the owner's design tokens or a reference scale, the app's own best screens and a calibrated bar, the Curator agent (tools Read and StructuredOutput, confined to its run's taste files) gives a verdict per row and files nothing, taste confirm replays each row on a fresh instance, taste file files the confirmed ones through scrub up to a cap a cycle, and report opens with the scorecard. A candidate that does not reproduce two of two, a harness failure and a run whose secret ledger is incomplete are journalled and never filed. The lane runs from the main session only, never inside /inspector.
title: /journey — one journey cycle
